outline: Students will acquire English competence to conduct business in the commercial world, including such areas as investment, finance, supply chain, marketing and sales, and risk management. Contemporary literature on world economies, free trade and capitalism will be read. In addition, the United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) will be introduced.
